$about: Copy to design-system.config.json at the project root. Every project-specific fact lives here; the kit holds none. Fields marked Phase 2 are read by nothing yet.
$system: The part-ID prefix: <system>/<group>/<Part>/<version>. NOT the CSS prefix.
$libraryKit: Optional path to the library's kit folder. A newer version there gives a warning (G18).
$generated: A raw value in a generated file says: fix it upstream.
$keptTokens: A token no source uses yet, with the reason to keep it. Stale entries fail.
$phase2: groups, themes and renamed are read by nothing yet (Phase 2: part IDs and the map).
